questions.question: strip() kya karta hai?
questions.answer: String ke start aur end se whitespace hata deta hai. Beech ki spaces nahi hatata.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: split() aur join() ka relation?
questions.answer: split string ko list me todta hai; join list ke strings ko separator ke saath ek string me jodta hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: find() aur index() me fark?
questions.answer: find() not-found par -1 deta hai. index() not-found par ValueError raise karta hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: replace() original ko modify karta hai?
questions.answer: Nahi. String immutable hai, replace() naya string return karta hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Method chaining kya hai?
questions.answer: Ek method ka result agle method ko dena, jaise text.strip().lower(). Ye compact aur readable ho sakta hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: isdigit()/isalpha()/isalnum() ka use?
questions.answer: Input validation ke liye. Ye batate hain characters digits, letters ya letters+digits hain ya nahi.
